review_notes: v037 is underdetermined and v038 selected, both resolving to the base; the English matches.
said* is folded onto πρός under rule 62 rather than marked added, since the prepositional phrase is the verbless clause's predicate and Ἀγρίππας stands as its subject.

persuasion is kept inside πείθεις's unit as the word glossing that lexeme; marking it added under rule 103 and heading the unit on wouldest remains defensible. The ASV's margin (In a little time) construes ἐν ὀλίγῳ temporally, which would not change the token pairings.
